verdict.rationale: Runloop has no documented built-in natural-language command interface; the CLI, dashboard and SDKs are conventional. The probe does report a first-party MCP server on the AI-tools page, which would let an AI assistant operate Runloop from natural-language requests, but its tool coverage is undocumented in the pack. The Cursor rules and LLM context files only help assistants write SDK code, so they are building blocks rather than direct operation. missing for 10: native natural-language interface in the CLI or dashboard, documented scope of what the MCP server can operate (devboxes, snapshots, blueprints), hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
